text:
Alyssa Chen: FYI we have ACME going live this Friday 11:00 UTC. They expect a burst during the first 30m. Can we confirm a warmup "fastpass" plan? :rocket:
Miguel Torres: +1. Recommend lightweight prefill + short warm pool before GF. Key asks: prefill size, batching windows, streaming fallback.
Jonah Patel: Quick checklist from ops side: prefill (X users), KV cache prime, set batch target to 8-16, enable streaming fallback for long responses.
Priya Rao: For onboarding UX, ask them to pre-seed top 10 prompts (they already have them). We'll surface a single-step prefill curl for customers.
Alyssa Chen: Nice. Miguel, can you propose numbers for warm pool sizing? We don't want to overcommit GPUs.
Miguel Torres: Suggested math: expected peak rps 120, avg tokens per request 250, target p95 latency < 400ms. Warm pool baseline: 4 replicas of g5.2x -> sustain ~100 rps with batching. Start with 2 replicas + burst policy to 6 for first 20m.
Theo Williams: SRE note: set autoscale burst policy TTL=20m, cooldown 5m. Add a fallback route to a smaller model to avoid 503s.
eng-sre-oncall: Added: alert if queue-depth > 300 or tail latency > 800ms for 5m window. Also create a runbook entry under incidents for this tenant.
Jonah Patel: I'll hand off the prefill job. Here's the curl we plan to give them:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"tenant_id":"acme","prompts":["<prompt1>","<prompt2>"]}'
```
Priya Rao: Also tell them to enable streaming in client for better perceived latency: `stream: true` and set client-side timeout 10s.
Alyssa Chen: What about batching config in Console? Any quick toggles?
Miguel Torres: In Console -> Dedicated -> Model config: set `max_batch_tokens`: 8192, `batch_timeout_ms`: 15, `target_batch_size`: 12. Those are safe defaults for chat-like traffic.
Theo Williams: Add telemetry check: verify token-level cost estimate in Console before go-live. Alert if cost/spike > 2x baseline.
Priya Rao: I'll capture feedback template for ACME post-go-live: NPS + perf checklist + any prompt drift notes. Short 5-question form.
Alyssa Chen: Perfect. Can we summarize into a 1-pager for the CSM and include the prefill curl + console toggles?
Jonah Patel: On it. I'll drop the doc in the CS workspace and ping the customer. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Deployment window reserved: Fri 10:30-12:00 UTC. Canary enabled.
Alyssa Chen: Thanks team. If anyone sees elevated errors during the burst, ping @eng-sre-oncall and I'll join the bridge. :phone:
eng-sre-oncall: Roger. Will monitor.
Miguel Torres: post-mortem note: after 30m, scale down warm pool to baseline 2 replicas and keep prefill cache TTL 10m to avoid long tail costs.
Priya Rao: Adding the feedback capture link to the handoff doc now.
Alyssa Chen: Closed-loop: we'll run a 1-day health check the next morning and decide renewal risk follow-ups.
Jonah Patel: Copy.
Priya Rao: :thumbsup:
